question: Based on last 10 open issues, propose 5 sub teams to split workload.
answer:
**Proposed sub‑teams (based on the themes of the 10 most recent open issues)**  

| # | Issue example (title) | Main focus / theme | Suggested sub‑team name | Typical tasks for the team |
|---|-----------------------|--------------------|--------------------------|----------------------------|
| 1 | “Update the README.md” | Documentation & user‑guide updates | **Docs & Community** | Keep README, wiki and release notes current; improve onboarding docs. |
| 2 | “Prevent stacktrace when there are no admin credentials” | Security / credential handling | **Security & Credentials** | Harden authentication flows, validate missing credentials, add tests for permission errors. |

4. **GitHub Integration & Hooks** – owns the interaction layer with GitHub (hooks, APIs, events), ensuring consistency across PRs.  
5. **Legacy Code & Deprecation** – cleans up old code, handles deprecations and edge‑case build‑status scenarios, keeping the codebase healthy.
